_maintainer_note: How much each brain can hold. (1) budgets are CEILINGS: a caller may ask for less, never more. (2) tool_budget is how many tools the brain is shown in one turn; Concierge always adds the core tools and fills the rest by the turn's words. (3) needs_thinking: true only for a model that cannot answer with thinking off; every other model gets think: false on answer calls, so a thinking model does not spend its whole reply budget thinking. (3b) think_in_chat: true turns thinking on for the brain's chat turns only (chat, the sample asks of puffpai check and Toolsmith's reuse asks), for a model that answers chat badly with thinking off: qwen3.5:9b (measured 2026-10-23, Ollama 0.40.4) then writes its reasoning into the answer and often skips a tool call it should make (ask_toolsmith after a chat that already talked about Toolsmith: 3 of 10 with thinking off, 8 of 10 with it on). Its JSON asks and Toolsmith's own turns stay off, because thinking made a short JSON ask take 1 to 2 minutes. Ollama returns the reasoning in its own thinking field, which the Core never shows or keeps. (4) basis is 'measured:<silicon_id>' only for a model benched on that board; everything else is 'conservative-default'. (5) '_default' is what an unknown model gets. The longest matching id prefix wins, and an inherited profile is never 'measured'. (6) vision: true only for a model that reads pictures; /v1/brain/chat refuses images otherwise.
